Metric definitions & percentile method
  • Average hit: mean duration of completed timers.
  • Median hit: middle completed duration.
  • Top-half duration: average of the longest half of completed timers, rounded up for odd samples.
  • Points per timer: rank points divided by all timers, including interrupted timers with zero points.
  • Consistency: 100 × (1 − min(standard deviation ÷ mean duration, 1)). Needs at least two completed timers.
  • Completion rate: percent of timers that finished manually instead of being interrupted.
  • Repeatability: percent of completed durations within ±20% of their median (minimum tolerance 0.1 seconds).
  • Recent form: average completed duration in the last five timers minus the preceding five. Requires a full 10-timer window and completed entries in both halves.

Current metrics use the latest 10 saved timers. Reference values come from all earlier 10-timer windows, excluding those latest 10 timers. At least 30 saved timers and 10 valid reference values are required.

Percentile = 100 × (reference values below yours + half the ties) ÷ valid reference values, rounded and bounded to 1st–99th. Equal values receive the middle rank. Each metric is compared separately; no composite percentile is invented.

Higher means a larger metric value relative to your history. Timings are manual and saved only in this browser.

    THE CARROT KINGDOM

    Royal Harvest

    👑🥕

    Seven spinning reels in a fruit-and-veggie slot machine. Five free spins each hour. No purchases, bets or cash prizes.

    SPINS LEFT5 / 5
    REFILL IN60:00
    👑 JACKPOT · 2× RANK POINTS1 in 100 chance per spin · 1% odds

    Five spins are ready.

    No bonus queued

    A jackpot doubles rank points on your next completed hit timer of at least 1 second. The normal 20-point cap becomes 40 points for that timer. Interrupted or shorter timers keep the bonus. One bonus can be queued at a time.

    How Royal Harvest works

    Every spin independently has a 1% jackpot chance. A jackpot displays a royal carrot formation in the center. Ordinary clusters of five or more adjacent matching symbols light up for fun; they award no rank points.

    You receive five spins immediately and refill to five every hour from your first visit. Unused spins do not accumulate. Availability, results and bonuses are saved in this browser; they do not sync with a Puffco account. Local clock or browser-data changes can affect availability.

    Rank points remain based on manual timers. The casino never starts or changes your device session. Finish any active timer before spinning. A “bonus session” means one completed hit timer, not the entire heating cycle.

    FANDUEL · DAILY BETTING ACTIVITY

    Most-taken lines

    🏟️

    No bet-volume feed connected.

      Live rankings require FanDuel bet counts. No lines are being invented or substituted with picks.

      Open FanDuel
      FanDuel’s Parlay Hub shows popular parlays and placement counts. Those are different from the most-taken individual sportsbook lines. Popularity is not a prediction.
      Connect bet-volume data

      Enter a public HTTPS JSON feed containing FanDuel placement counts. It must allow browser requests. An odds feed or percentage split alone cannot establish the most-taken lines across games. No sportsbook login or private API key is used here.

      Feed schema: sportsbook = "FanDuel", date = YYYY-MM-DD in America/New_York, updatedAt = ISO timestamp, coverage = "all-lines" or "partial", sourceUrl = HTTPS source, lines = an array of entries with event, selection, market, line, odds, betCount, startsAt (ISO timestamp). Only games starting today are shown. Full-sportsbook rankings require coverage="all-lines" and complete source data.

      Imported snapshots are labeled as snapshots and expire at midnight Eastern. A connected feed refreshes when you open Casino and every 15 minutes while that tab is open.
